bio.text: Shimon Blau is an unaffiliated candidate for Colorado's 1st Congressional District in the 2026 general election; Colorado Politics describes him as a medical doctor who launched his campaign within days of the Democratic primary.
According to his campaign website, he was born and raised in Denver's Sloan's Lake neighborhood and returned to Denver in 2013 to complete a fellowship in interventional spine and pain management.
The site says he has since built a medical practice in the Denver area and is also a small business owner.
